snippet.title: Life Is Strange: Reunion Gameplay Trailer (Masquerade Scene) - Future Games Show Spring Showcase
snippet.description:
Deck Nine Games shared an exclusive chunk of gameplay from Life is Strange: Reunion, a brand new adventure in the LiS universe that sees Max and Chloe reunited at last. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on March 26th.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2624870/Life_is_Strange_Reunion/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
